statement: For each of the11 remaining originals assign its actual sheet; only second-sheet parts select a profile and proxy coordinates. Sort selected identical copies first, with their profiles in x order; all remaining copies are mandatory first-sheet obligations. Identical-family allowed profiles, stock domains, pair constraints, area coefficients and objective weights make this relabelling invariant. Absent coordinate variables may be assigned any domain value: every stock/pair/cell/rectangle constraint involving the absent original is inactive, and its presence-prefix condition does not constrain actual first-sheet geometry. Selected parts satisfy the separately audited all-angle/continuous proxy map, necessary direction/gap/order constraints, fresh band bounds and inner-rectangle nonoverlap. The proved subset cut and outward-relaxed first-sheet area inequality follow from any source continuation. Thus all source continuations extend to this model without deleting an original; positives and objective optima remain necessary relaxations, not layouts or H5 acceptance.
